resolutions.start_name: Rover Pipeline tie-in, southern Wood County, Ohio (proxy point on Cygnet Road)
resolutions.end_name: Apollo Power Generation Facility, Ohio 582 and Mercer Road
resolutions.researcher_notes: The end is the Apollo power plant at Ohio 582 and Mercer Road, good to about half a kilometer. The start is only a proxy. The news article says the line begins at a Rover Pipeline connection in southern Wood County near Cygnet Road and Wingston Road, so the point is the Cygnet Road and Wingston Road intersection. The real tie-in could be several kilometers away. The straight line is about 16 miles, while a contractor notice states 23.5 miles of 20-inch pipe, so the real route is longer and bends. No route map has been found. The Ohio Power Siting Board letter of notification in case 26-0624-GA-BLN should replace this line.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Traced from Figure 1.B.1 of the public filing, a 1 to 336,000 map that draws the project corridor. The line is the main lateral plus two short branch laterals, one running west near US Highway 80 and one running northwest toward Louisiana Highway 852. The yellow boundary is drawn wider than the pipe, so position is good to a few hundred meters.
